Title: Onboard a new merchant via portal endpoint using multipart form data
Preconditions: The MMS application is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/v1/onboarding/portal with content type multipart/form-data (or form URL-encoded) containing the parameters in testData. 2. Verify the HTTP response status and body content.

Test Data: mobileNumber=01670000000, merchantName=Zamal Uddin, businessType=CORPORATION, tradeLicenseNo=12354345, email=zamal@example.com, nidNumber=9123456789, storeName=ABC Store - Dhaka Branch, storeLocation=123 Gulshan Avenue Dhaka, notificationMobileNumber=01670636253
Expected Result: HTTP status code 201 Created is returned with a success response body containing message 'Merchant onboarded successfully'.

Title: Reject portal merchant onboarding request when required fields are missing
Preconditions: The onboarding service is running and accessible.
Expected Result: The request is rejected with HTTP status 400 Bad Request with validation errors indicating that mobile number, merchant name, business type, NID number, store name, and store location are required.

Title: Reject portal merchant onboarding request when email address format is invalid
Preconditions: The onboarding service is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/v1/onboarding/portal with the payload in testData containing a malformed email format.

Test Data: {
  "mobileNumber": "01670636253",
  "merchantName": "Zamal Uddin",
  "businessType": "CORPORATION",
  "email": "invalid-email-address",
  "nidNumber": "9123456789",
  "storeName": "ABC Store - Dhaka Branch",
  "storeLocation": "123 Gulshan Avenue, Dhaka"
}
Expected Result: The request is rejected with HTTP status 400 Bad Request stating that the email address format is invalid.

Title: Successfully submit merchant onboarding request via portal endpoint
Preconditions: The application service is running and connected to integrated KYC and store management services.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/v1/onboarding/portal with multipart/form-data or form-urlencoded parameters using valid merchant portal onboarding data provided in testData.

Test Data: mobileNumber=01670636253&merchantName=Zamal Uddin&businessType=CORPORATION&tradeLicenseNo=12354345&email=zamal@example.com&nidNumber=9123456789&storeName=ABC Store - Dhaka Branch&storeLocation=123 Gulshan Avenue, Dhaka&notificationMobileNumber=01670636253
Expected Result: The HTTP status code is 201 Created and the response body confirms 'Merchant onboarded successfully'.

Title: Application starts up and connects to PostgreSQL database successfully with updated credentials
Preconditions: PostgreSQL database 'mms_db' is running at localhost:5432 and user 'postgres' with password 'Abc@1234.' is configured with database access permissions.
Steps:
1. Deploy application with updated application.yml containing username 'postgres' and password 'Abc@1234.'. 2. Start the mms-app service. 3. Monitor startup logs for datasource connection pool initialization. 4. Trigger an API request requiring database access (e.g., application health check or merchant fetch).

Test Data: Old credentials: username='mms_user', password='mms_password' | New credentials: username='postgres', password='Abc@1234.'
Expected Result: Application starts up successfully without datasource authentication errors or connection timeouts, and successfully executes queries against mms_db using the postgres account.
